summary: IDS feed s165_triple is degraded: 86% encrypted traffic exceeds 60% tolerance, 2.2% jumbo frames exceed 1518-byte port MTU and are dropped, and 6.6% TCP packet loss indicates genuine capture drops. IDS requires full payload and bidirectional visibility, so all three reduce detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 86% of bytes are TLS-encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance. Traffic is sent to IDS without decryption or selective bypass on the packet broker, so payload remains opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot apply signatures or payload inspection to encrypted flows; detection is limited to headers/metadata, causing missed exploits, C2 and malware over TLS.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs_full_payload=true to detect intrusions. Decrypting relevant TLS at broker (or forwarding to dedicated SSL visibility appliance) and re-encrypting/policy-bypassing sensitive categories restores cleartext for inspection while staying within tolerance.

findings.root_cause: 169 of 2575 TCP packets (6.6%) show missing data/gaps. Frames were validated via IP header length so slicing is ruled out as cause; loss is genuine capture-path loss, typical of SPAN oversubscription or packet broker buffer exhaustion.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS receives incomplete TCP streams, fails stream reassembly and signature matching across packets, leading to false negatives and missed multi-packet attacks.

recommended_fix.why: SPAN/mirror drops packets under load before broker. Replacing SPAN with passive TAP and ensuring broker has sufficient buffer/aggregation eliminates the capture loss that slicing did not cause.

findings.root_cause: 60 of 2713 frames (2.2%) exceed IDS port MTU of 1518 bytes, largest 8058 bytes. Upstream network/broker forwards jumbo frames while IDS 1Gbps capture NIC is set to standard 1518 MTU.
findings.impact_on_tool: Oversize frames are dropped by IDS NIC before analysis, creating blind spots. Tool needs full payload so broker-side slicing/trimming to 1518 would break IDS detection and is not an option.

recommended_fix.why: Because IDS requires full payload, cannot use slice to fit MTU. Must either enable jumbo frame support end-to-end to the tool or normalize MTU upstream to 1518 to prevent silent NIC drops.
